mechanics.claim: Casting Shattered Earth resets Skarner's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Casting Shattered Earth resets Skarner's basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Shattered Earth's duration is paused while Ixtal's Impact is active.
mechanics.quote: Shattered Earth's duration is paused during {{ai|Ixtal's Impact|Skarner}}.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attacks deal proc damage rather than spell damage.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attacks lack spell effects as they deal {{tip|proc damage}}

mechanics.claim: Attacks are consumed only when they land, not simply on use.
mechanics.quote: consume empowered attacks only when they landed. (This way the attacks are not consumed when the target died beforehand.)

mechanics.claim: Only the third empowered attack (or Upheaval) triggers the maximum-health damage and slow; the first two hits deal only the flat/AD/bonus-health damage.
mechanics.quote: The final attack slams the boulder, dealing an additional {{as|11% of each target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: Upheaval ends Shattered Earth by throwing the boulder, dealing the same damage as the final empowered attack, without needing to land a basic attack.
mechanics.quote: '''Skarner''' ends ''{{ai|Shattered Earth|Skarner}}'' by throwing his boulder in the target direction. It explodes upon colliding with the first enemy hit, applying the same damage and slow to the target and surrounding enemies as ''Shattered Earth's'' final empowered attack would.

mechanics.claim: The additional maximum-health damage is capped against monsters and does not apply to structures.
mechanics.quote: The additional damage is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}} and is not applied against structures.

mechanics.claim: Shattered Earth's cooldown starts on cast but restarts each time an empowered attack lands or Upheaval is cast.
mechanics.quote: Starts on-cast, but restarts each time an empowered attack is used as well as after casting Upheaval

mechanics.claim: While Shattered Earth is active it does not benefit from cooldown refund effects.
mechanics.quote: While ''Shattered Earth'' is active, it will not benefit from cooldown refund effects such as {{ri|Transcendence}} or {{iis|Navori Flickerblade}} {{nie|Transcendence}}.

mechanics.claim: Only the third hit of Shattered Earth triggers Tear of the Goddess and Archangel's Staff mana-related effects.
mechanics.quote: Only the third hit of ''Shattered Earth'' triggers {{ii|Tear of the Goddess}} and {{iis|Archangel's Staff}} {{nie|manaflow}}.
